finalText:
**Migration done in `packages/`.** 12 files still used `db.query`. All 36 calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its top comment says edits are wiped on upgrade. Two `db.query` calls remain there.

I ran every exported function. All 325 database calls used the new form. No syntax errors.

`cache.query` is a different thing, so I did not touch it.
